Pages, databases and blocks that a Notion connection has been given.

## API key

1. Open [app.notion.com](https://app.notion.com/developers/connections) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An internal connection's API token (a workspace owner creates the connection in Notion's developer portal).

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add notion
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  notion: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Notion's [API](https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show notion` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 180 a minute. Per connection: 180 a minute, 600 on Business and Enterprise; data source queries about 3 per second.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Notion account once, then allows each app that uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/notion-oauth/callback
```

A public integration: only a public one has a client ID and secret.

1. Open [notion.so](https://www.notion.so/my-integrations) and create an OAuth app (also called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Copy the client ID and client secret. The secret is often shown only once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add notion-oauth
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

List the provider's own scopes in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  "notion-oauth": { scopes: [], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Use [Notion's scopes](https://developers.notion.com/reference). The app calls Notion's API with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the person's token. A token with more scopes than your apps list is refused.

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show notion-oauth` shows the client as set. Then open an app that lists it and select its **Connect** button.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Notion).
